text: Ascale's website footer reads 'ASCALE es una marca de' above the Pamesa Grupo Empresarial logo; Pamesa Grupo Empresarial's history page says the group acquired Best Surface, now ASCALE, in 2023 and created Ascale as a commercial brand in 2024.
short: Ascale is a brand of Pamesa Grupo Empresarial.
